<div class="card-body">
'''Chief Bast''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Imperial]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">バスト隊長</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">戦闘のはじめに、宇宙船に乗っている場合、即座に、他に1名のキャラクターを連れて、同一星系内の位置に、即座に脱出（移送）することができる。ターキンと同じ位置にいる場合、戦闘力＋１。バストが操縦する宇宙船は、戦闘力＋２になる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-165o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">グランドモフ・ターキンの副官。決して敵を過小評価しない。若い頃に親しんだ狩りによって、狡猾さと忍耐力を身に付けたのだ。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Chief Bast.

'''Card text:''' At the start of a battle, if aboard a starship, may immediately evacuate (relocate) with one other character to a site in the same system. Power +1 if at the same site as Tarkin. A starship Bast pilots is power +2.

'''Lore:''' Aide to Grand Moff Tarkin. Never underestimates the enemy. Hunting as a youth taught cunning and patience.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese relocates to a site in the same system; the English relocates to a related site.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Chief Bast]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 98. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
